# Daily Report — 2026-09-15

## Task Completed
Added `list_locations` and `get_location` tools for the `cmn_location` table. `list_locations` supports filtering by name, city, country, and company with full pagination. `get_location` resolves by sys_id or exact name with a 404 guard. Both tools normalise reference fields (parent, company, contact) and return address data including street, city, state, country, zip, phone, fax, latitude/longitude, and time_zone. Registered in system_administrator and full packages.
